reviewer: independent_review: source-and-reference review; separate from benchmark author

cases.reason: No idle receive miss -> intervening buffered Put -> first Get queues while idle -> later Get consumes idle -> later Put wakes original trace; `close-accounting-and-deferred-waiter` overtaking via Close is a different ordering.
Get queues at capacity, subsequent Put pops oldest and sends same connection; with no Release or expiry the condition covers P02.

findings.reason: Factory/Release and below-capacity paths match channel.go:82-88,150-161; "wrapped factory error" ambiguous because fmt.Errorf uses %s, not %w, so error unwrapping is not retained.

Get invokes Close and skips expired or ping-failed entries (channel.go:115-126), but Close callback can return error and no callee guarantee establishes that the connection was successfully physically closed.
Queued request and FIFO Put send are explicit under lock; Release detaches without closing req channels, late Put cannot deliver; handed value expiry checked and Ping skipped.
Release detaches conns and callbacks then drains saved channel, ignores callback errors; in-flight old channel read may race drain, as described with validation disabled.
Put does not track ownership; each call queues same object twice, and second overflow invokes Close leaving first buffered.
Close decrements before callback regardless of error and does not touch waiters; subsequent Get may create at reduced count.
